iso_mapping.6.4 EnPIs: Expected vs actual energy, deviation %, SEC (GJ/ton)
iso_mapping.6.5 Energy baseline: Regression EnB per SEU on the baseline period, with R², CV(RMSE), p-values

iso_mapping.10.2 Continual improvement: Corrective actions, future improvements, stretch targets

definitions.expected_gj: Energy predicted by the EnB model at the actual production and ambient temperature.
definitions.deviation: Actual minus expected. Positive = worse than the baseline predicts.
definitions.cusum_gj: Cumulative sum of monthly deviation since the baseline ended. A rising line means a persistent loss.
definitions.decomposition: Change vs an average baseline month = volume effect + weather effect + efficiency effect (exact). Only the efficiency effect is a performance change.
definitions.status: critical: last-3-month mean deviation >= 2 x band; high: >= band; watch: worsening drift/step still inside the band; improved: <= -band; normal otherwise.
definitions.annualized_excess: Mean of the last 3 months' positive deviation x 12, valued at the configured tariff (PLACEHOLDER rates).
definitions.stretch: Further saving below the model, beyond noise, shown by the best 10% of months (best demonstrated performance).

limitations: Hypotheses and actions come from a generic knowledge base and must be verified on site.
Tariffs and emission factors are placeholders unless replaced in the notebook CONFIG.
Models are statistical; re-baselining after real changes follows the controlled procedure, not this tool.
A deviation outside the band shows that something changed vs the baseline model, not by itself what changed.
